title: A new upper bound on the dimer constant of $\mathbb{Z}^3$
summary: We prove that the dimer constant of the cubic lattice is bounded above by $0.452130$, improving the previous best upper bound of $0.457547$ obtained by Lundow (2001) using the transfer-matrix method of Ciucu (1998). Our construction instead uses diagonal transfer layers and an inequality of Csikvári (2017) to relate the spectral radius of the resulting matrix to the dimer constant, rather than exploiting symmetry special to the rectangular torus.
